target.statement: Wan-Move achieves FID 12.2 on MoveBench (single-object motion control), outperforming baselines.

compute.basis: Generating 1018 videos with a 14B-parameter diffusion model requires GPU inference; even a single video takes minutes on a high-end GPU, and the full benchmark would take hours.

blockers: Requires 14B-parameter model inference (Wan-I2V-14B) which needs a high-end GPU (e.g., A100 80GB) and cannot run on a CPU-only laptop.
MoveBench contains 1018 videos; evaluating FID requires generating all of them, which is computationally prohibitive on a laptop.
title: Wan-Move: Motion-controllable Video Generation via Latent Trajectory Guidance
